section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the strengths, limitations, and future research directions of a single study examining the relationship between overhearing family fat talk, mindful eating, and positive body image among college women. The study was limited to college women who primarily identified as White or European American, and the authors recommend future research replicate findings with ethnic minority women, undergraduate men, and community samples. Key limitations include the use of a nonclinical sample, lack of longitudinal/experimental design to test causality, relatively small effect sizes for functional body appreciation, and measurement limitations regarding which family members engaged in fat talk and the applicability of the functional body appreciation measure across diverse populations.
